name: Vivek Chowdary

Published IEEE conference paper author (ICoECIT 2026) with research experience in predictive healthcare modelling. Strong foundation in DSA, OOP and core CS fundamentals — seeking a Software Engineer role to design, build and ship scalable software.

projects.name: Quantum Aggregate Signature for VANET
projects.description: Independent reproduction of a 2025 research paper on quantum aggregate signatures for vehicular networks. Built a quantum simulator in Python/NumPy (BB84 QKD, entanglement-based signatures, aggregation, teleportation), formally verified the protocol with Scyther — 17/17 secrecy and agreement claims, finding and repairing an attack in the authors' own model — and reproduced the performance evaluation in OMNeT++ with 46 vehicles and zero message loss. Also uncovered a public-forgery weakness in the published scheme and proposed a hardened variant.

projects.name: Smart Campus Lost & Found Portal
projects.description: Full-stack portal that automatically matches lost and found reports across a 5,000+ student campus. JWT authentication, Cloudinary photo uploads, a cosine-similarity matching engine with an 80%+ match rate, real-time Socket.IO chat to arrange handovers and a Recharts analytics dashboard. Deployed on Vercel/Render with sub-2s page loads.

projects.name: AI Code Reviewer
projects.description: AI-powered code review platform — paste code and get instant feedback. Monaco Editor (the editor behind VS Code) in the browser, Groq's LLaMA 3.3 70B for fast reviews, Piston API for sandboxed multi-language execution and Socket.IO for real-time updates. Frontend on Vercel, backend on Render.

projects.name: ClientSync
